plain_result: The separate answer-writer attempt stopped because of a model-file path bug in the audit. Its saved answer scores remain ungraded; no behavioral pass or fail has been assigned.
question: Can a new connection make the frozen language host choose the supplied answer from eight candidate labels?

attempt_design.writer: One new bias-free linear connection with 8,192 trainable weights, supplied only eight outcome probabilities. The language host was fixed by the protocol.
attempt_design.scope: An answer-code communication check. It does not test rule discovery, planning, a joined reader/writer or use of unseen world rules.
attempt_design.data_exposure: The 24 question contexts and 96 saved probability vectors were already exposed in development. Eight question combinations were excluded only from this new writer fit.

failure.stage: Independent audit, before numerical checks and answer scoring.
failure.explanation: The audit required model files to remain inside a snapshot directory. Normal model-cache links point to files elsewhere in the same model cache, so the path check rejected them.
failure.model_file_hash_followup: A metadata-only follow-up confirmed that all nine resolved model files matched the registered hashes. This does not complete the failed numerical audit.

work_accounting.status: Verified from stopped-run metadata, not from answer scoring
